title: Article Outline
description: Output of outline-architect. Stored at memory/workspace/{task_id}/outline.json. Word budgets must sum to ≈word_count_target ±5%.

abstract_seed.description: One-sentence framing for the Abstract section

tldr_seed.description: Pre-Abstract TL;DR block content (≤540w grounding zone)

takeaways_seeds.description: Key Takeaways list items (4-7, each ≤20 words)

word_budget.description: Target word count for this section. Sum of all sections must = word_count_target ±5%

section_intent.description: Why this section exists (search intent / funnel stage / E-E-A-T signal)

is_featured_snippet_target.description: If true, this section gets the most answer-first extractive 40-60w capsule. CONSUMED (since v3.35) by the citation-capsule-builder stage dispatch — the retired featured-snippet-optimizer merged into it (FS and AIO select the same extraction shape; Ahrefs 2025: FS 83% replaced by AIO). See references/seo/serp-feature-value-2026.md.

snippet_format.description: DEPRECATED v3.35: was meant for the never-wired featured-snippet-optimizer; consumed by nothing. Tolerated on legacy outlines; do not emit.

design_components.description: Visual design components the writer should realize in this section, assigned by outline-architect per the article format (see references/style/visual-design-components.md). A comparison_table entry should be paired with needs_table:true.

seed_questions.description: FAQ questions; ≥60% must come from research.paa per v3.2 spec

paa_alignment_pct.description: Fraction of FAQ questions derived from research.paa

cta_placement.description: DEPRECATED v3.34 (2026-07-04): was produced by outline-architect but consumed by NOTHING (Rule-6 orphan data). CTA placement is now deterministic — scripts/optimize/cta_injector.py reads business-context.json :: cta (project-level config), not the per-article outline. Tolerated on legacy outlines; do not emit for new ones.

total_word_budget.description: Sum of all section word_budgets (sanity check)

expected_table_count.description: ≥2 tables required, at least 1 in front 50%
